FIELDS.NAME: Harmony Arts Academy
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Emily Johnson, Director of Operations, Harmony Arts Academy, emily.j@harmonyartsacademy.com, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Harmony Arts Academy, we offer a diverse range of classes in dance, drama, and music for students of all ages and skill levels. Our core operations focus on providing high-quality, engaging instruction led by certified and experienced professionals. We emphasize safety and compliance, ensuring that all our instructors possess the necessary qualifications and undergo comprehensive background checks, particularly when working with minors. Our facilities are purpose-built, featuring modern safety features such as sprung floors and secure sound systems, and we regularly conduct safety audits to maintain compliance with local regulations. We have established documented procedures for risk management and emergency responses, which are reviewed and practiced through regular safety drills. Our structured training programs include ongoing professional development for staff to enhance their instructional skills while ensuring a safe environment for all participants. Each class is designed to deliver age-appropriate content, fostering a creative and supportive atmosphere for our students. Through partnerships with accredited institutions, we continually evaluate our curriculum and teaching methods, aspiring to meet the highest standards in arts education.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: "In March 2022, we experienced a minor incident where a student sprained their ankle during a dance class due to improper footwear. The total cost of medical assistance was approximately $300. The matter was resolved internally, and no claims were filed. As a result, we took additional measures to educate students about appropriate footwear requirements during classes."
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 456 Creative Arts Way, Suite 200, Springfield, IL 62701-4567
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Saturday: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secure storage room for musical instruments and equipment, with keypad entry and monitored alarm system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security services for events and performances, including professional fencing personnel and watchpersons, to ensure student safety and prevent unauthorized access.
